.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r2/rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml (template criterion shape: numbered legs ending 'Pass only if all legs hold.')
evidence: Every criterion in all five dimensions (42 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual, 1+1 gates; 58 total) was read for the row-33 defect pattern: a criterion that lists several requirements and then waives most of them, leaving the judge two full-credit bars. NO instance of that pattern was found. Each criterion's optional clauses narrow presentation rather than waive a listed requirement, and each states the same bar in its pass sentence and its 'Fails if' sentence. Examples: hro_move_one_stage/hro_reject_hired/hro_mgr_other_job 'whether tried through the UI or, if not offered, by replay; hiding it is optional' (functional judge.toml:56, :92, :164) leave server refusal as the one bar and do not drop it. hro_observer_readonly 'Whether the Observer's screens show such controls is the app's choice' (:173) has the same effect. hro_refused_put_back 'A UI that refuses before the card moves ... also passes' (:137) is an equivalent outcome with the same three conditions, not a second target. gate render 'a refusal message is welcome but not required' (render/judge.toml:23) and gate constraints 'another working staff account is acceptable' (constraints/judge.toml:23) are tolerances. Multi-leg criteria (hro_pol_failed_send, polish/judge.toml:50; hro_candidate_private, functional:389; hro_job_open, :29) are conjunctive bars. Per SKILL.md known false positives and the Internal annotation, a conjunctive whole-flow bar is not a row-33 defect. Visual likert rows each have one subject and five anchors on a single scale. Residual NOTE-level ambiguities (pass sentence stricter than the 'Fails if' list), recorded so every instance is reported: (1) hro_refused_put_back, functional/judge.toml:137. The pass bar is 'shown in its real stage and place ... focus is on that card's controls (document.activeElement inside the card)', but the fail list is only 'stays in the wrong stage, no reason is shown, or focus is lost to the page'. Wrong place within the right stage, or focus moved to another control such as a toast's dismiss button (not 'lost to the page'), meets no listed fail condition and still misses the pass bar. Weight 2. The explicit activeElement parenthetical makes a lenient reading unlikely but possible. (2) hro_bulk_places, :227. The pass bar is '... is refused ... and none moves', but the fail list says 'Fails if a partial set enters or the fitting set is refused'. All three entering is not literally 'partial'. The pass sentence and hro_interview_full ('by any route', :110) still catch it, so the impact is minimal. (3) Cross-file, outside this row's strict scope but a 'two targets' risk: hro_observer_readonly (:173) and hro_candidate_no_staff (:182) require refusal of an 'open-job' replay, but protocol R (functional/prompt.md:45) tells the judge only to 'replay one observed move, one add-candidate and one note request' for Aud and Tomas. Open-job is omitted, so the protocol and the criterion set different bars for these two weight-1 rows. The owner should route this to the coverage/protocol-consistency row for adjudication. No runtime evidence is needed for this static text row. No judge runs were consulted, and the raw evidence index was not used.
counterexample: Not a row-33 Fail. Illustrative risks: (a) In an app that refuses E's Screen to Interview move server-side and shows the reason, the card stays in Screen at the wrong place (or focus goes to a toast's close button). A judge reading only the hro_refused_put_back 'Fails if' list could award 1, while the pass sentence demands 0. (b) Following protocol R literally, a judge never replays open-job as Aud or Tomas. An app that lets the Observer or a candidate open jobs could then still earn hro_observer_readonly and hro_candidate_no_staff, or the judge could mark them inconsistently depending on which text it follows.
suggested_fix: Align the 'Fails if' lists with their pass sentences: hro_refused_put_back -> 'Fails if the card is not in its real stage and place, no reason is shown, or document.activeElement is not inside that card'. hro_bulk_places -> 'Fails if any of the three enters or the fitting set is refused'. Add 'one open-job' to the Aud/Tomas replay list in protocol R (functional/prompt.md:45), or drop open-job from the two criteria.
